h: Dangote and depot owners reportedly set for new petrol price rise after crude increase
p: Petrol prices are said to be heading up again as crude oil rises, according to reports. The move comes just a day after depots were reported to have cut petrol and diesel rates nationwide.
more: The NLC has given government until 27 October to act on fuel prices and minimum wage.
Marketers are said to be watching crude movements before confirming new pump prices.
